Aditi & Parichay

The cocktail night: an English garden after dark

Event
Cocktail
Venue
JW Marriott Golfshire
Location
Bengaluru
Date
October 2025
Guests
250+
Category
Pre-Wedding

A ballroom turned into a moody garden: velvet drapes, hand-painted bird murals, a checkerboard floor and wild meadow planting spilling from terracotta urns.

Leather chesterfields with monogrammed cushions created intimate lounges under the murals, while a curved arch bar glowed at the far end of the room.

Sunflowers, pampas and dried grasses gave the florals texture and warmth, balanced by candlelight on every table.

  • Painted bird mural backdrops
  • Monogram cushions on chesterfields
  • Meadow planting in terracotta urns
  • Arched backlit bar
